fact.headline: Not official airline support.
fact.body: airlineschat is traveler-to-traveler chatter about delays, bags, refunds, and rebooking. For ticket changes, claims, or compensation, use the airline's official app, website, or airport desk. EU261 / US DOT rules are public law — this room is not counsel.

outbound.headline: Keep PNR + photos before you post
outbound.snippet: Strong traveler notes include confirmation code, flight number, timestamps, and bag tag photos. Never paste full payment card data in the room.
